♎ The Libra Cloth. OFFENSE/DEFENSE

Signature Technique

@UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rozan Rising Dragon]

Cloth Passive — The Cloth of Arms

Yours is the only Cloth with weapons. You are trained in martial weapons, and your martial weapon proficiency advances with your unarmed proficiency for the rest of your career.

The Cloth carries six pairs of weapons — swords, tridents, nunchaku, shields, sanjiegun, and tonfa. You can summon or dismiss any of them as a free action. They can never be disarmed or destroyed, and they accept weapon runes normally.

Ascendant Boon — The Balance [OFFENSE/DEFENSE]

You can wield any two Libra weapons regardless of how many hands they would normally require.

Your Libra weapons count as having one higher fundamental rune tier (to the game's maximum). You gain a +2 status bonus to all saving throws, and the first natural 1 you roll each hour counts as a 10 instead.

Applied by @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-effects.Item.Sky: Ascendant (Libra)]

Zenith Boon — The Balance (Zenith) [OFFENSE/DEFENSE]

As the Ascendant Boon, and you gain @UUID[Compendium.isaacs-hb-pf2e.saint-techniques.Item.Rozan Hyaku Ryu Ha], usable once per round.
